# Muhammed Sahal K C

> Muhammed Sahal K C (also written Sahal K C; handles msahalkc and sahal.kc) is a software
> engineer, SDE 2 at FantaCode (fantacode.com) in Kozhikode, Kerala, India. He grew up in Kannur,
> studied Computer Science and Engineering at MES College of Engineering, Kuttippuram, and started
> as a graphic designer before moving into software. He designs and builds his own products.

## Projects
- [Asset Build](https://msahalkc.com/asset-build): a private personal-finance tracker (assetbuild.in). Manual entry with no bank, SMS or email access; gold, investments and chit funds add up into one net worth in any currency. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Capacitor.
- [ExtenD](https://msahalkc.com/extend): a free, open-source (MIT) app that turns an iPad into a second display for a Mac over USB-C or Wi-Fi, with touch and Apple Pencil, without a shared Apple Account (extend.msahalkc.com). Built with Swift.

## Experience
- SDE 2, FantaCode, Kozhikode (2026–present); Software Development Engineer, FantaCode (2024–2026)
- React Developer Intern, Tecnavis Web Solutions (2024)
- Chief Technical Officer, IEDC MESCE (2023–2024)
- Graphic Designer, Applied Knowledge Sciences, remote (2023–2024)
- Freelance Graphic Designer (2021–2024)
